claim_text: We remain committed to the rehabilitation of the Ranger Project Area to a standard that will establish an environment similar to the adjacent Kakadu National Park, a World Heritage site.
context_text: We remain committed to the rehabilitation of the Ranger Project Area to a standard that will establish an environment similar to the adjacent Kakadu National Park, a World Heritage site.；In 2025, we met our guidance provided to the market in 2024, spending ~$1 billion on closure activities as we progressively rehabilitate our operations and progress work at Argyle, Ranger, the Gove alumina refinery and legacy sites.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告提供了closure spend，但没有给出能够证明Ranger已达到接近Kakadu环境状态的实际生态结果数据。
notes: commitment型表述；支出不是该环境结果的直接证据。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is a commitment to rehabilitate the Ranger Project Area to a standard that will establish an environment similar to the adjacent Kakadu National Park. The evidence substantiates that the company is undertaking closure and rehabilitation-related activities and reports spending approximately $1 billion on closure activities in 2025 while progressing work at Ranger (among other sites). However, the evidence does not substantiate the specific outcome standard claimed—i.e., that rehabilitation will establish an environment similar to Kakadu National Park—because it provides no criteria, milestones, performance measures, timelines, or results demonstrating progress toward or achievement of that Kakadu-like environmental standard for the Ranger Project Area.
